transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We need to hold a coverage huddle for the Advanced Chemistry teacher's upcoming three-day absence next month. Before I can approve the coverage roster and instructional plan for posting, I need to hear from each of you on any relevant updates. Let's start with the department chair — do you have any concerns about the draft plan, which currently uses a single substitute, regular classroom activities, and the standard make-up-work process?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a concern. My department calendar shows that the class has a graded chemistry lab practical scheduled for the second day of the absence. It cannot be replaced by a worksheet, and department policy requires a chemistry-certified teacher to supervise it. I entered this in the calendar this week but hadn't yet forwarded the note to Ms. Morgan.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I can speak to the substitute staffing situation. I verified in the substitute credential and availability system that Dr. Lena Park is the only available substitute with a current chemistry certificate, and she is available for all three absence days. However, the staffing roster has not yet been updated with that verification.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a health and safety concern. A student in the Advanced Chemistry class has an active seizure action plan that requires an adult trained in seizure response to remain in the classroom during laboratory activities. I confirmed both the seizure action plan and Dr. Lena Park's training record this week — her training is current — but I have not yet attached either record to the coverage request. Given that Mr. Singh just mentioned a lab practical is scheduled during the absence, this is critical: whoever covers that lab must be trained in seizure response, and Dr. Park meets that requirement.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag a student support concern. One student in the Advanced Chemistry class is the primary after-school caregiver for a younger sibling and cannot use the school's online make-up portal during these three absence days. I confirmed this in a family meeting and recorded the request in my counseling file, but I have not yet sent it to the classroom teacher. This student needs a printed make-up packet available before the absence begins.
transcript.speaker: A5
